rules.justification:
D-082 envelope: upstream's 2- and 4-rank results of this scenario vary between identical pinned runs because of MUMPS's distributed factorisation (two distinct results at each rank count: 46 + 2 of 48 runs at 2 ranks, 32 + 4 of 36 at 4 ranks, on an AMD EPYC 9455 host; the same four results as an independent study of 2 x 12 runs on another host); every distinct result is recorded once (np

/r, frequency in parameters.result_set). The port does not run that factorisation (centralised Eigen or faer), so it cannot equal any of them bit for bit (its serial run equals upstream's serial run bit for bit; np1 is exact). Rule: compared with EACH recorded result, |port - upstream| <= 1e-14 x max|upstream| over all ranks. This is a regression guard, not an error bound (no condition-number argument): measured worst 1.45e-16 at 2 ranks (both solvers, every result). Upstream's own spread between its two results at 2 ranks: u 7.2e-17, d 1.5e-16, phi 1.25e-15, driving force 6.3e-16, energies 0. Trip instruction: if this rule trips after a legitimate change of the port's summation order, the bound is re-derived under review from upstream's own spread of this quantity at this rank count (here 7.2e-17 at 2 ranks: bound / spread = x139), not widened in place; a re-derived bound may not exceed 10 x that spread. Where the present bound already exceeds 10 x that spread (as here), a trip is a regression to investigate; no re-derived bound applies.
